issuing_orgs: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
synopsis: The purpose of the notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Laboratory Centers (LCs). The LCs will provide a framework for laboratory leadership, structure and activities that contribute to the HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Networks research agendas and execute the laboratory component of Network trials, in compliance with applicable regulatory standards.
title: HIV/AIDS Clinical Trials Network Laboratory Centers (UM1 Clinical Trial Required)
